source: Algemene termijnenwet art. 3 (algemeen erkende feestdagen) and rijksoverheid.nl 'Officiële feestdagen'; King's Day by Besluit van 2013 (27 April from 2014). Verified 2026-10-04.
notes: Dutch law does not grant days off itself — the CAO / employment contract does; these are the days commonly off. Easter Sunday and Whit Sunday are left out (always Sundays). Good Friday and Liberation Day (5 May; in many CAOs only every 5 years, e.g. 2025, 2030) are off only if your CAO says so — add them as company days. King's/Queen's Day on a Sunday moves to Saturday, so it never lands on a workday.
